name: TC3 — Unpaid invoice is still accepted
description:
Confirms payment status does not gate ingestion: an invoice with status "Unpaid" (amount_paid = 0.00) is still accepted the same way a "Paid" invoice is.

**Note:** "Unpaid" as the exact status string was unconfirmed against a real example when this test was written (the integration guide only showed "Paid") — this test run itself is what confirms whether that string is correct.

**Expected:** HTTP 200 with body {"status":"accepted"}, regardless of payment status.
